tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: near-black forest green. Also the ink on live-filled controls (active filter pill, hovered CV button).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Solid panel fill: portrait well behind the photo. Too close to bg to read as a separate block on its own, so always pair it with a line border.

tokens.name: panel-glass
tokens.usage: Panel tint. Layered over bg so panels are opaque (the line color behind grid gaps would otherwise bleed through). Kickers and status pills use it with a line-strong border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines only: section dividers, the 1px gaps between grid panels, the 48px blueprint grid. 2.47:1 on bg, so never a control's only border; use line-strong for that.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on controls and labels: tags, filter pills, hobby chips, the CK mark, kicker and status pills, the portrait ring, the rule after section labels. 3.86:1 on bg, 3.36:1 on panels.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and panels (16.8:1 on bg). Warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, labels, inactive nav, tags, metadata (9.9:1 on bg). The source drops it to 0.7 opacity for 'since' dates and to 0.4 for decorative side labels; keep those uses decorative.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The brand accent and the 'system is up' signal: links, active nav, live dots, stat values, focus outlines, hover borders, terminal output (11.4:1 on bg).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Structure accent: section headings (h2), the role line, terminal prompt, hover underline on nav, tag-like leads (8.2:1 on bg). Never used for state.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warm accent kept rare: link hover in the hero link row, the terminal's middle traffic-light dot (9.2:1 on bg).

tokens.name: terminal-red
tokens.usage: Literal in the source: only the terminal title bar's first traffic-light dot. Not a UI error color.

tokens.name: nav-glass
tokens.usage: Sticky top-nav backdrop (bg at 60%), with blur(14px) saturate(160%).

tokens.name: terminal-glass
tokens.usage: Terminal window body: darker than bg, translucent, with blur(18px) saturate(160%).

tokens.name: terminal-bar
tokens.usage: Terminal title bar fill (panel at 50%).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner border on glass panels and the terminal; the faint lit edge of the glass.

tokens.name: meter-track
tokens.usage: Empty track behind a meter fill.

tokens.name: live-tint
tokens.usage: Live at 10%: CV button resting fill and the cursor spotlight glow inside panels.

tokens.name: live-halo
tokens.usage: Live at 18%: the 4px ring around the active rail-nav dot.

styles.name: hero-name
styles.usage: The h1 name only. Source: clamp(3.2rem, 7vw, 5.6rem) on an 18px root, so 58–101px.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page title on Projects and Guides: clamp(2.6rem, 5vw, 3.8rem).

styles.name: role
styles.usage: Typewriter role line under the name, in signal.

styles.name: section-headline
styles.sample: What actually happens between a merge and a deploy.
styles.usage: The one-line intro under a home section label, in text, max 30ch. 25.2px under 760px.

styles.name: summary
styles.sample: I design and ship cloud infrastructure.
styles.usage: Hero lede (1.15rem), text-dim, max 58ch. Also the intro on Projects and Guides.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Short, practical notes on how I approach the stack.
styles.usage: Default body. The html root is 18px.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Panel h3 (1.1rem), -0.01em. Guide titles go up to 22.5px.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: A few things I've built or shipped.
styles.usage: Project summaries and guide bullets (0.93rem), text-dim.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Count-up numbers in live, with a live glow once visible.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Section h2 eyebrow: mono, uppercase, 0.08em tracking, in signal, numbered 01–04 in text-dim and followed by a short line-strong rule.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Top nav links, kicker, status list, footer (0.85rem).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Filter pills, rail labels, dates, terminal title (0.78rem).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tag and pill gaps; the terminal dot gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Dot-to-text gap in status rows, hobby chip gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Rows inside a skill list; padding above a pipeline record.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Link-row gap, kicker margin, nav vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Mobile panel padding and page gutter.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Nav link gap; heading-to-content margin in sections.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Desktop right gutter; gap between stats.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Desktop panel padding; padding above the stats row.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: The blueprint grid pitch, hero bottom padding, hero copy-to-portrait gap.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile (under 760px); the hero's bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-104
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every home section on desktop, closed by a line rule.

tokens.name: gutter-left
tokens.usage: Desktop left content inset, clearing the fixed rail nav. Drops to 24px under 760px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of .wrap and the footer.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything rectangular: panels, tags, pills, buttons, terminal. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-meter
tokens.usage: Meter track and fill only.

tokens.name: radius-label
tokens.usage: Rail-nav label backdrop only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circles: status dots, rail dots, terminal dots, the CK monogram, the portrait.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Top-edge highlight on every glass panel.

tokens.name: shadow-terminal
tokens.usage: The terminal window: the only element that lifts off the page.

tokens.name: shadow-live-ring
tokens.usage: Ring around the active rail-nav dot.
